notes: BTRFLY migrated to DINERO at a 1:2000 ratio in July 2024. All allocations are scaled accordingly.
The Incentives allocation is used to incentivize current and future Dinero products, funding liquidity pools and building Dinero's non-DINERO treasury.
There's no defined schedule or mechanism for the unlock of the incentives allocation. We followed the linear schedule from the graph in the official tokenomics.
